lead: Double glass terrarium measuring 70x45x97 cm with a handmade 3D background. Two separate compartments for keeping two animals in one enclosure.
imageAlt: Double glass terrarium 70x45x97 cm with 3D background - NS Reptiles

description.html: These are two terrariums in one enclosure, placed one above the other. The outer dimensions are 70x45x97 cm, and each compartment has its own 70x45 cm floor, its own sliding glass, ventilation and 3D background. The total volume is about 305 liters. We make it by hand in Novi Sad.

Since the 97 cm height is divided into two levels, each compartment has slightly less than half that height. That suits a pair of crested geckos or tree frogs per level. For adult chameleons and larger arboreal snakes one level is too low, so choose a single tall terrarium for them. This way two animals that must not be kept together take up the space of one terrarium.

The ratio of the heights of the upper and lower compartments can be changed, for example a taller upper one for a climbing species. Because of the weight and height, arrange delivery with us before ordering, and the build takes 7 to 14 days. The background in each compartment can have a different relief, rock in one and bark in the other.
